title: Parts of Speech and Word Order

vocabulary.meaning_en: the groups that words belong to, like noun, verb and adjective
vocabulary.example: Noun and verb are two parts of speech.

vocabulary.meaning_en: word order: where words go in a sentence
vocabulary.example: English syntax puts the adjective before the noun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that names a person, place, thing, animal or food
vocabulary.example: "Apple", "Toronto" and "boy" are nouns.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that replaces a noun, like he, she, them
vocabulary.example: In "James ate the apple and he walked his dog", "he" is a pronoun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a pronoun that does the action: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
vocabulary.example: "We" is a subject pronoun: We eat dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a pronoun that receives the action: me, you, him, her, it, us, them
vocabulary.example: "Them" is an object pronoun: I'm talking to them.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a pronoun that points back to the subject: myself, himself, herself...
vocabulary.example: He built the house himself.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that describes a noun or pronoun
vocabulary.example: In "a black cat", "black" is an adjective.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word for an action or a state of being
vocabulary.example: "Eat", "sleep" and "work" are verbs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that describes a verb, an adjective or another adverb
vocabulary.note_ar: كثير من الظروف تنتهي بـ -ly مثل quickly
vocabulary.note_en: Many adverbs end in -ly, like quickly.
vocabulary.example: In "I ran quickly", "quickly" is an adverb.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how someone or something is (not an action), e.g. happy, sick
vocabulary.example: "I am sick" describes a state of being.

vocabulary.meaning_en: saying or doing the same thing again and again
vocabulary.example: Using the same noun many times is repetitive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how many or how much
vocabulary.example: "Five" shows quantity.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how good or bad something is (opinion)
vocabulary.example: "Nice" and "bad" are quality adjectives.

vocabulary.meaning_en: where something comes from
vocabulary.example: "Italian" shows the origin of the sofa.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what something is made of, e.g. cotton, metal, glass
vocabulary.example: Leather is the material of this sofa.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the form of something, e.g. round, square, long
vocabulary.example: What shape is the table? It's round.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not important
vocabulary.example: It is an insignificant mistake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: longer than it is wide
vocabulary.example: We have an oblong table in the kitchen.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very happy and full of energy
vocabulary.example: The children were exuberant after the trip.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long soft seat for two or more people (sofa)
vocabulary.example: We bought a new couch for the living room.

fine_lines.title: adjective vs adverb
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصفة تصف الاسم أو الضمير (a quick runner). الظرف يصف الفعل (runs quickly) ويمكن أن يصف الصفة أيضًا (very expensive).
fine_lines.explanation_en: An adjective describes a noun or pronoun (a quick runner). An adverb describes a verb (runs quickly), and it can also describe an adjective (very expensive).

fine_lines.title: subject pronoun vs object pronoun
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ضمير الفاعل يقوم بالفعل ويأتي قبله (I, we, they). ضمير المفعول يستقبل الفعل ويأتي بعده (me, us, them).
fine_lines.explanation_en: A subject pronoun does the action and comes before the verb (I, we, they). An object pronoun receives the action and comes after the verb (me, us, them).

fine_lines.title: so / very vs too
fine_lines.explanation_ar: so و very تعنيان "كثيرًا" بدون معنى سلبي. أما too فتعني "أكثر من اللازم" وغالبًا تعطي معنى سلبيًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "So" and "very" mean "a lot". "Too" means "more than I want" and is usually negative.

examples.sentence: It was very hot, so we went to the beach.
It was too hot, so I stayed at home.

expressions.example: What is this bag made of? It's made of leather.
This sofa is made in Italy.

expressions.meaning_en: A question when you don't know who "he" is.

grammar.title: Nouns name things
grammar.explanation_ar: الاسم يسمّي الأشخاص (James)، والأماكن (Toronto)، والأشياء (watch)، والحيوانات (cat)، والطعام (apple).
grammar.explanation_en: Nouns name people (James), places (Toronto), things (a watch), animals (a cat) and food (an apple).

grammar.title: Pronouns replace nouns (noun first!)
grammar.explanation_ar: نستعمل الضمير بدل الاسم حتى لا نكرره. لكن يجب أن نذكر الاسم أولًا ثم الضمير، وإلا لن يعرف السامع من نقصد. أنواعه: ضمائر الفاعل (I, we)، ضمائر المفعول (me, them)، والضمائر الانعكاسية (himself).
grammar.explanation_en: Use a pronoun so you don't repeat the noun. But say the noun first, then the pronoun, or people won't know who you mean. Types: subject pronouns (I, we), object pronouns (me, them), reflexive pronouns (himself).
examples: James went to the store and he bought apples.

grammar.title: Adjectives come before the noun
grammar.explanation_ar: الصفة تصف الاسم أو الضمير. في الإنجليزية تأتي الصفة قبل الاسم، عكس العربية: نقول a black cat وليس a cat black. وتأتي بعد فعل be: The cat is black.
grammar.explanation_en: An adjective describes a noun or pronoun. In English it goes before the noun: "a black cat", not "a cat black". After the verb "be" it comes alone: "The cat is black."

grammar.title: Order of adjectives
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نستعمل عدة صفات نرتبها هكذا: 1) العدد 2) الرأي/الجودة 3) الحجم 4) العمر 5) الشكل 6) اللون 7) المصدر 8) المادة، ثم الاسم.
grammar.explanation_en: With many adjectives, use this order: 1) quantity 2) quality/opinion 3) size 4) age 5) shape 6) color 7) origin 8) material, then the noun.
examples: five nice big old long blue Italian leather couches

grammar.title: Verbs: actions and states
grammar.explanation_ar: الفعل يدل على حدث (eat, sleep, work) أو على حالة الكينونة باستعمال فعل be مع صفة (I am happy, it is hot). الفاعل يقوم بالفعل والمفعول به يستقبله: I eat an apple.
grammar.explanation_en: A verb shows an action (eat, sleep, work) or a state of being with "be" + adjective (I am happy, it is hot). The subject does the action; the object receives it: I eat an apple.

grammar.title: Adverbs and their four types
grammar.explanation_ar: الظرف يصف الفعل ويأتي عادة بعده (I ran quickly)، ويأتي قبل الصفة التي يصفها (so expensive). أنواعه: الطريقة (slowly)، الزمان (yesterday)، المكان (here)، الدرجة (very, so, too).
grammar.explanation_en: An adverb describes a verb and usually comes after it (I ran quickly). It comes before an adjective it describes (so expensive). Four types: manner (slowly), time (yesterday), place (here), degree (very, so, too).
examples: I ran quickly to my house.

questions.question: Which word is a noun?
questions.explanation_en: "Apple" names a food, so it is a noun.

questions.question: "James ate the apple and ___ walked his dog."
questions.explanation_ar: نحتاج ضمير فاعل قبل الفعل: he.
questions.explanation_en: We need a subject pronoun before the verb: he.

questions.question: Which is a reflexive pronoun?
questions.explanation_ar: himself ضمير انعكاسي يعود على الفاعل.
questions.explanation_en: "Himself" points back to the subject, so it is reflexive.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I have a cat is black.
questions.explanation_ar: الصفة تأتي قبل الاسم في الإنجليزية.
questions.explanation_en: In English the adjective comes before the noun.

questions.question: Choose the correct adjective order.
questions.explanation_ar: الترتيب: الحجم ثم العمر ثم اللون.
questions.explanation_en: The order is size, then age, then color.

questions.question: "I ran ___ to my house."
questions.explanation_ar: نحتاج ظرفًا يصف الفعل ran: quickly.
questions.explanation_en: We need an adverb to describe "ran": quickly.

questions.question: "Yesterday" is an adverb of ___.
questions.explanation_ar: yesterday تخبرنا متى حدث الشيء، فهو ظرف زمان.
questions.explanation_en: "Yesterday" tells us when, so it is an adverb of time.

questions.question: Which sentence describes a state of being?
questions.explanation_ar: She is happy تصف حالة وليس حدثًا.
questions.explanation_en: "She is happy" describes how she is, not an action.

questions.question: "It was ___ hot, so I didn't go out." (more than I like)
questions.explanation_ar: too تعني أكثر من اللازم وتعطي معنى سلبيًا.
questions.explanation_en: "Too" means more than I want; it is negative.

questions.question: What does "syntax" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: syntax تعني ترتيب الكلمات في الجملة.
questions.explanation_en: "Syntax" means the order of words in a sentence.
